# PANaCEa — LLM Context File

> AI-optimized project description for agent discoverability

## Purpose
PA student cognitive prosthetic — not flashcards, a teaching engine. Evidence-based learning platform with three competitive moats: content-aware intelligence, implicit mastery inference (Ghost Grader), adaptive pedagogical depth.

## Stack
- React 19 + TypeScript strict + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS
- Cloudflare Edge (Hono) + Prisma 7 + Supabase Postgres
- Gemini AI (2.5-pro, 2.5-flash) + Clerk auth
- Vitest 4.1 testing, 2700+ tests

## Key Paths
- `components/session/QuizView.tsx` — Main study session (1900 lines)
- `components/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx` — Home dashboard (847 lines)
- `components/landing/` — Landing page (5 modular components)
- `functions/api/` — Edge API (461 functions)
- `lib/scoring/` — FSRS v6 + scoring engine
- `services/` — Domain services (169 files)
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — Data models (165 models)

## Commands
- `npm run dev` — Vite dev server
- `npm run build` — Production build (~16s)
- `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` — Test suite (avoids OOM)
- `npx wrangler dev` — Cloudflare Workers local
- `npx wrangler deploy` — Deploy to production

## Architecture Rules
- Binary rating ONLY (Again/Good) — never Hard/Easy or self-rated difficulty
- Only review_type 'real' with MAIN/DRILL sessions update FSRS
- Par time is per-question-type, not global
- Never process.env in Edge — use context.env.*
- Never Prisma in frontend, never skip safePrismaDisconnect

## Status
- Production build: PASSING
- Edge migration: ~100% complete
- Landing page: Complete (cinematic, modular)
- In-app UI overhaul: Phase 3 in progress
